name: Steamed or boiled crab
summary: Ghẹ is steamed or boiled with a little beer or a little water. A soft-shell crab is sometimes stir-fried with lá lốt or salt-fried.
howToEat: Steam or boil with a splash of beer or water. A soft-shell, when there is one, is stir-fried with lá lốt or rang muối.
where: The ordinary seafood meal in the 9 Jul 2015 account. The same account’s meal at Cái Dăm in Hạ Long started with ghẹ lột xào lá lốt.
seoTitle: Ghe in Ha Long — steamed, boiled, or soft-shell
seoDescription: Ghẹ in Hạ Long is steamed or boiled with a little beer or water.
